title: Ninja III: The Domination
description: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

title: The Mighty Quinn
description: Police officer Xavier Quinn (Denzel Washington) believes his childhood friend was framed for murder to protect the local tourism business.

title: Out Of Time
description: Denzel Washington is caught in a web of intrigue as he investigates the murder of a woman he was seeing...and all the evidence points to him.

title: Thief
description: Michael Mann ("Manhunter") directs this stylish, action-packed drama that stars James Caan ("Misery") as a master safe cracker who is planning his last heist for the sake of a woman, Tuesday Weld ("Who'll Stop The Rain?"), and a new life.

title: The Thomas Crown Affair (1999)
description: In this sizzling action film, when thrill-seeking billionaire Thomas Crown (Pierce Brosnan) ingeniously steals a priceless painting from a museum, he's pitted against the beautiful insurance investigator (Rene Russo) hired to retrieve the artwork.

title: The Thomas Crown Affair (1968)
description: Sophisticated, handsome Thomas Crown (Steve McQueen) is the intellect behind a bank robbery so stunning, it has Boston's finest completely baffled.  Faye Dunaway is the sleek and smart insurance investigator out to bring him in.

title: The Great Train Robbery
description: Sean Connery plans to steal a fortune in gold from a railroad payroll car and joins forces with safecracker Donald Sutherland and his own girlfriend, Lesley Anne Down, in a series of intricately plotted thefts that will test their larcenous skills.

title: The Bounty
description: Anthony Hopkins delivers a brilliant portrayal as William Bligh, the sea captain who, in 1787, steered The Bounty on a 27,000-mile voyage into danger, chaos and madness, and whose first mate (Mel Gibson) lead a legendary mutiny against him..

title: Rob Roy
description: Liam Neeson and Jessica Lange give extraordinary performances as the legendary hero who refused to let his enemies destroy his honor and the loyal woman who gave him the courage to fight! Tim Roth, in an Oscar®-nominated performance, also stars.

title: The Barbarians
description: It is in the time of dragons, witchcraft and sorcery! An evil ruler enslaves a beautiful young queen and she bears him three children. Years later, with the help of a wild young barbarian outlaw woman, her twin sons set out to free their mother.

title: Hercules (1983)
description: Created by Zeus from the energy of a thousand suns, armed with the strength of a hundred men, Hercules triumphs over the forces of darkness in this thrilling adventure that's bigger than the myth itself! Stars Lou Ferrigno and Sybil Danning.

title: The Adventures Of Hercules
description: Lou Ferrigno returns as Hercules, the man with the strength of a hundred! When Zeus' seven mighty thunderbolts are stolen by a group of traitorous goddesses, it's up to Hercules to save the universe from chaos! William Berger also stars.

title: Hercules (2014)
description: Dwayne Johnson stars as the most towering myth of all time, revealing the man behind the legend in this bold reimaging of the famed Hercules!

title: The Man In The Iron Mask
description: Leonardo DiCaprio leads a phenomenal cast in this thrilling tale of majesty and Musketeers. When the excesses of France's arrogant King Louis XIV begin to threaten his subjects' very lives, the legendary Musketeers reunite to save their country!

title: Flesh + Blood
description: Betrayed by power. Bound by honor. In the battle between good and evil, only the strong survive! From visionary director Paul Verhoeven comes this epic adventure of medieval bravery and blood lust starring Rutger Hauer and Jennifer Jason Leigh.

title: Bulletproof Monk
description: Chow Yun Fat and Seann William Scott star in this heart-pumping action-adventure when a mysterious Tibetan monk, who has protected a powerful scroll for 60 years, believes he has found his successor in a pick-pocketing, streetwise punk.

title: Pray For Death
description: A vicious gang forces Akira to shed his quiet persona and reveal his other identity...that of a skilled Ninja!

title: Convoy
description: Feuding with Sheriff Lyle Wallace (Ernest Borgnine), Martin Penwald (Kris Kristofferson) unites scores of his fellow-drivers via Citizen Band radio into a mile-long convoy which, powered by pent-up resentments, rolls along the Arizona highways.

title: Over The Top
description: A championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Lincoln Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted. Sylvester Stallone stars in this powerful and exciting film!

title: The Crocodile Hunter: Collision Course
description: Steve and Terri Irwin set out to save a crocodile, unaware that it’s swallowed a U.S. satellite beacon, and now they’re targets of the CIA! Crikey!

title: Anti-Trust
description: In this sizzling, fast-paced thriller, computer whiz Milo Hoffman (Ryan Phillippe) lands his dream job at a major computer company, only to learn that the C.E.O. (Tim Robbins) may employ some very unorthodox -- and very deadly --business practices.

title: State Of Grace
description: An undercover cop (Sean Penn) comes back to his old neighborhood in Hell's Kitchen to bring down the Irish Mafia.

title: At Close Range
description: A farm boy (Sean Penn) looking for excitement finds himself on a collision course with his smooth-talking gang leader father (Christopher Walken) in this "powerfully disturbing" (Newsweek) tale based on the story of real-life killer Bruce Johnston.

title: 52 Pick-Up
description: In this tense thriller, Roy Scheider has it all until a trio of pornographers shows up with a video of him in bed with his mistress. When he tries to pit one blackmailer against the other, the tension mounts - as does the possibility of murder.

title: The Hot Spot
description: A drifter (Don Johnson) moves into a small town and into a torrid affair with a local woman (Virginia Madsen). But when he falls in love with someone else (Jennifer Connelly), he finds himself trapped in a dangerous web of revenge and murder!

title: Bandits
description: Strap yourself in for one hilarious action-comedy starring Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton and Cate Blanchett! Convicts Joe (Willis) and Terry (Thornton) run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife (Blanchett).

title: Harley Davidson And The Marlboro Man
description: Mickey Rourke and Don Johnson star in this four-lane genre collision of biker movie, heist thriller, buddy flick and sci-fi pic that will take you to the hardline of action and adventure! Co-starring Tom Sizemore, Chelsea Field and Vanessa Williams.

title: Malone
description: Ex-CIA agent (Burt Reynolds) has his quiet life disrupted when he stumbles onto a military conspiracy led by a rightwing zealot (Cliff Robertson).

title: Force 10 From Navarone
description: From director Guy Hamilton comes this action-packed WWII adventure! Screen legends Robert Shaw and Harrison Ford star as fearless commandos on a deadly mission to strike a crippling blow against Hitler's army during the darkest days of World War II.

title: Hart's War
description: Bruce Willis stars as an imprisoned officer who refuses to give up his fight against the Nazis, even from behind enemy lines. With the help of a young lieutenant (Colin Farrell), he risks everything to free his men and change the outcome of the war!

title: Windtalkers
description: John Woo directs this epic, action-packed drama about a WW II soldier (Nicolas Cage) assigned to protect a Navajo soldier (Adam Beach)...and the secret code he knows. Christian Slater, Roger Willie, Peter Stormare and Mark Ruffalo also star.

title: Navy Seals
description: Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn and Bill Paxton are three of America's finest Navy commandos. Sent to rescue the crew of a U.S. aircraft carrying Stinger missiles seized by Mideast terrorists, they're thrust onto the frontline of an explosive conflict!

title: No Man's Land (1987)
description: When a rookie cop goes undercover at a Porsche garage doubling as a chop shop, the fast cars and wild parties have him thinking that his suspect has the life he wants. But there may be more going on than just car theft...and he may be in too deep!

title: RoboCop
description: Classic sci-fi adventure about a cop...part man...part machine...the future of law enforcement.

title: RoboCop 2
description: In this thrilling sequel, Robocop returns to fight his toughest opponent yet...his replacement!

title: RoboCop 3
description: When a greedy corporation starts evicting families in favor of a very profitable real estate project, RoboCop (Robert John Burke) joins with a renegade band of freedom fighters to save them. But RoboCop must also face a new deadly android!

title: RoboCop (2014)
description: In 2028 Detroit, when Alex Murphy (Joel Kinnaman) -- a loving husband, father and good cop -- is critically injured in the line of duty, the multinational conglomerate OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.

title: The Delta Force
description: Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage…and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

title: Delta Force 2: The Colombian Connection
description: Chuck Norris is in peak form in this explosive action/adventure that brings back one of his most unforgettable characters, Delta Force Colonel Scott McCoy, for a daring mission to destroy a deadly drug cartel led by the ruthless Billy Drago!

title: Colors
description: As members of the Los Angeles Police Department's elite anti-gang unit, a seasoned cop (Robert Duvall) and his new partner (Sean Penn) are called in to assist with the crackdown against the mounting gang violence in the slums of East Los Angeles.
